summary: Iteration 22: Full E2E test of Agenda employee_ids + location feature. Backend (6/6 pytest passing) + Frontend (all 10 review scenarios verified via Playwright). Admin creates appointment with Daniel assigned + location → card shows yellow Daniel Oliveira badge + location. Edit dialog pre-fills, time change persists. Tech portal (Daniel) sees ONLY his appointment via /api/tech/appointments/my with time_start—time_end + location. Non-Daniel appts filtered out. Admin sees ALL on tech endpoint. Backward compat (missing employee_ids) OK. Cleanup executed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_appointment: model_dump() inserts all fields but there is no admin/role check — any authenticated user (including techs via JWT) could POST /api/appointments. User story says 'somente o adm pode agendar'. Add role guard (require admin/supervisor) on POST/PUT/DELETE /api/appointments.
AppointmentCreate has no validation that employee_ids exist as real employees; invalid IDs are silently accepted. Consider validating existence to avoid orphan assignments.

Conflict check in create_appointment blocks ANY same-slot appointment globally, even if assigned to different techs. Two techs can legitimately have parallel appointments — consider scoping the overlap check by employee_ids intersection.
PUT /api/appointments/{id} uses same global overlap check — will reject valid parallel assignments across different techs.
TechAgendaPage does not show a badge or field indicating who else is assigned (multi-tech visibility). Minor UX gap.
AgendaPage employees list uses /api/payroll/employees which may include inactive; filter e.active !== false is already applied (good). Consider also filtering by role/tech flag.
